name: moola
description: Your net worth, accounts, balance history, transactions, and financial health from Moola.

interface.longDescription:
Moola brings your whole financial picture into ChatGPT. Ask how your net worth is moving, what you hold where, or where your money went, and get answers from your own Moola workspace: bank-linked and manual accounts, balance history, transactions, and a Health score built from a dated, published rulebook.

ChatGPT can review your Health and save a prioritised plan into Moola, keep your books tidy (account types, categories, merchant rules, manual balances), and record the money moves you agree to so Moola can confirm them when your balances change.

Moola never moves money. It reads, labels, and records; you act at your bank. You choose read-only or read-and-write access when you connect, and you can disconnect at any time in Moola's Settings.
defaultPrompt: What's my net worth in Moola right now?
Review my financial health in Moola and suggest a plan.
